chris.49k: The new stretcher bearer gave his name as Hugo "Lucky" Chris. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.

A sneeze blew dust off the shelf above Hugo "Lucky" Chris. This caused another sneeze and a discussion about moving the shelf. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Hugo "Lucky" Chris watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
daone101: Viktor "Crow" Daone took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Viktor "Crow" Daone stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

Across from S-R1, an enemy soldier stood up to stretch. Viktor "Crow" Daone saw it. Isidor Shitsherlock was grazed. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Viktor "Crow" Daone wrote to a fiancée who wears his ring on a chain that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
dfault_niel: Tobias Niel left a landlady who kept his room exactly as it was behind in Wyvern Cross and came up the line with a stub of a pencil. The men noticed at once that he hates silence more than shelling.

A bullet hit Tobias Niel's belt buckle at R-C10 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Clement "Tin" Natakhtasha of the Concord (@natakhtasha). On Day 10, Blackwater Canal passed to the Hegemony. Tobias Niel wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.

The wound on Tobias Niel's hand healed crooked, but it healed. He can hold a rifle and a mug, and those are the two things that matter. Tobias Niel got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 707. The men who came later will ask about it. The Hegemony took Grey Mill, and the orders at R-C10 changed before the cheering ended. Tobias Niel shouldered another load.
happy_hopper06: At the depot, Yann Hopper had practised answering to his name. At V-F13, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate. Yann Hopper transferred to the signallers. The men in V-F13 said they would miss him. He is only three dugouts away. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Yann Hopper read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
itswangz_007: Day 9: Roland "Whistle" Itswangz reached T-F11 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.
The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Roland "Whistle" Itswangz watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

Roland "Whistle" Itswangz checked the fire step after the shelling. The wall had moved, and the spot where he always put his foot was gone. After the loss of Grey Mill, Roland "Whistle" Itswangz helped stack spare sandbags at T-F11. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
ljuliolemosl: Day 10: Jakub Ljuliolemosl reached Q-F8 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.

Jakub Ljuliolemosl mended a split glove with pale thread. One finger now looks like it has been promoted. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Jakub Ljuliolemosl helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
panco_cos: Nobody saw Norbert Cos arrive. One morning there was simply one more helmet in P-F10, and a quiet machine gunner under it.

The gun team argued about who carried the heaviest load. Norbert Cos offered to swap loads. The argument ended at once. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Norbert Cos helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
str8.rotten: Cyril Rotten signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at S-S13 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.
Cyril Rotten was halfway through a story when his listener fell asleep. He counted that as a success.
Across the wire at Hill 304, Cyril Rotten of the Hegemony held up a sign: 'How is your coffee?' Quentin "Shadow" Danny of the Concord held up a sign back: 'Worse than yours.'
Cyril Rotten found a blank menu card and wrote the evening ration on it in elaborate handwriting. The bread became 'Bread, in the Army Manner'.
Word came down the line: Blackwater Canal is ours. Cyril Rotten shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.

Cyril Rotten fired at the enemy dawn watch from S-S13. Gustav Mini was grazed, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down. A bullet went through Cyril Rotten's upper arm at S-S13 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Shot by Lucien "Tin" Wtm of the Concord (@the_e_point_wtm). The clerk counted the names twice. Cyril Rotten is number 457 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Cyril Rotten did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
thefreakones: On the way to Q-F17, Walter Thefreakones tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way.

A bullet went through Walter Thefreakones's sleeve at Q-F17 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Valentin Peebles of the Concord (@miles.peebles). Grey Mill has been won. Walter Thefreakones listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
